obd.translation: abbr. 车载自动诊断系统（On-Board Diagnostics）；光束偏转（Optical Branching Device）；全方位距离导航系统（omnibearing-distance system）

obdicut.definition:
The rejection of all logic and facts that do not support a predetermined conclusion.

To cherry pick information.

The opposite of Occam's (or Ockham's) razor.

Someone who ignores opposing hypothesis, or viewpoints.

Self sustaining ignorance.
> They used the obdicut method of research and shoved their heads in the sand.

obdiplostemonous.definition:
a. Having twice as many stamens as petals, those of
   the outer set being opposite the petals; -- said of flowers.
obdiplostemonous.translation: [医] 外轮对瓣的(指雄蕊群), 具外轮对瓣雄蕊的(指花或植物)

obdiplostemony.definition: n. The condition of being obdiplostemonous.
obdiplostemony.translation: [医]外轮对瓣式, 具外轮对瓣雄蕊式

obduct.definition: v. t. To draw over; to cover.
obduct.translation: vt.[地]将(地球一板块)挤压至另一板块之上

obduction.definition: n. The act of drawing or laying over, as a covering.

obduracy.definition: n resoluteness by virtue of being unyielding and inflexible
obduracy.translation: n. 顽固, 执拗, 冷酷

obdurate.definition:
s stubbornly persistent in wrongdoing
s showing unfeeling resistance to tender feelings

obdurately.definition: r in a stubborn unregenerate manner
